Population increased in Fenland

The estimated population of Fenland in 2024 was 104,896 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Fenland's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Fenland increased by 2.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Fenland was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Fenland

The average (median) age fell to 44.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Fenland has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Fenland is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Fenland's population of 104,896 usual residents was made up of:

  • 18,394 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 61,994 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.1%)
  • 24,508 people aged 65 years and over, (23.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Fenland has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Fenland, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Fenland
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Fenland, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 234 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 988 births and 1,222 deaths in Fenland.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,169 (1.1%). There were 6,374 people entering the area and 5,205 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Fenland's population of 122 (0.1%) as a result of 717 people entering the area and 595 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Fenland was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Fenland in mid-2023 is 103,700.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 157 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 6 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 163 people.
